generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch MY2027 on SPA3, 800 V (shared with the 2026 EX90): P6 ~83 kWh, P10 ~95 kWh, P12 ~117 kWh; Volvo US cites up to 370 kW DC (P10/P12; P6 quoted 320 or 350 kW, unsettled); native NACS port. EPA lists P6 and P10 for 2027; no NRCan rows yet. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.volvocars.com/us/media/press-releases/BDD05C75EC286F35 ; https://www.kbb.com/car-news/2027-volvo-ex60-debuts-with-400-mile-range ; https://theevreport.com/volvo-ex60-lands-in-u-s-at-58400-starting-price
